statement: Amendment 2, recorded after outcomes were read. No locator or model output is rerun or changed; rows.json and the response files are unchanged.

items.detail: 36 units (144 method cells: codemapper and its three layers) are kept as recorded errors (request, no placement), as the protocol requires; rates excluding errors are reported beside them. Causes by error text: {"PermissionError": 20, "renamed path (native-readonly reads the old path)": 13, "unsafe native resolver command": 2, "TimeoutError('cm 60s timeout')": 1}. No rerun, so the frozen outcomes stand.

The GitHub arm placed multi-line threads at `line` (the last line); corrected to `startLine` (falling back to `line`) in analyze_wpk6.github_output before the reported summary. This is a scoring fix of a non-locator baseline; it raises GitHub placement and does not affect any locator.

analyze_wpk6.wraps/mechanisms classify each missed re-check by whether the applied suggestion contains the unchanged stripped quotation as a contiguous run (the suggestion wraps the reviewed lines). Defined after the misses were read; reported as a post hoc mechanism analysis.
run_wpk6_llm.analyze had a crash in the class count (dict iterated as list); fixed without touching predictions. The wrap-mechanism breakdown of both arms (wrap_n, wrap_flagged) is post hoc.
